source_read: https://sohocoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026-Allergen-Matrix-V11-Autumn-18.09.26.pdf (18 pages, footer 'Version 10: 14th September 2026', sha256 ba569027acd75d16f77939002e4f1cf72f273d8602034f65ebb4d0a15f867f60) and the drinks nutrition guide https://sohocoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-Nutritional-Matrix-Drinks-V4-Autumn-Drinks-26.08.26-1.pdf (sha256 472f53c0ac3fc47bba88c9cc91cc5bc76020d5b00de7f3fc8c79cd58ffb2d740), both downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, one GET each after reading robots.txt (sohocoffee.com disallows only a WP Defender trap path). The nutrition script re-run on them reproduces data/source/soho-coffee-co/items.csv byte for byte.
decision: NOT PUBLISHED: no exact allergen row for about 70% of the published drinks (more than the one-third limit), and the rest of the drinks would need two tables combined. Link-only stays; no allergens.csv written and no data changed.
notes: The matrix lists each drink once and states on every drinks section that 'allergen info is with Whole Milk. For alternative milks allergy info please see the specific section' (Cloud Coolers: 'Milk Substitutions are not available'; Matcha and Iced Matcha: 'with Oat Milk'). The nutrition guide that publishes the numbers lists every milk as its own row and size: 198 published items (213 rows less 15 held back for nutrition) = 171 products x milks x sizes. Counting by the matrix's own heading rule, at most about 27 published rows (whole milk, no milk and the Oat Matcha rows) could be tied to a matrix row of the same drink; a literal same-name row exists for only 2 (Espresso, Whipped Cream) because the matrix names drinks differently ('House Mocha' against 'House 32% Mocha', 'Iced Mocha' against 'Iced 32% House Mocha', 'Iced Long Black' against 'Iced Americano', 'House 32% Hot Chocolate', 'Iced Chocolate Praline Cloud Cooler' against 'Iced Praline Chocolate Cloud Cooler'). The 137 skimmed, soya, coconut and oat (non-matcha) rows have no row at all: their allergens would be the whole-milk drink's row combined with the separate 'ALTERNATIVE MILKS' page (Rude Health and Alpro, two brands per milk, while the guide says the brand can change, and skimmed milk is not on that page). That is combining two tables, which the contract forbids (DATA.md: copied exactly, never inferred), and the matrix has no per-item may-contain column. Beyond the one-third limit, so link-only stays (the existing allergen_guide.csv links the matrix). If SOHO published an allergen row per drink and milk, or the founder wants whole-milk drinks only (publishing a chain at that scale would hold back 70% of the menu), the script already counts same-name rows (--allergen-pdf) and would need a name map reviewed by hand.
